items.title: Day 1 · Reel · Shot 01 — "Nobody under forty is finding La Grotta" (Myth-Buster)

script.hookArchetype: Myth-Buster — it's not the food, it's one line of Google text
script.format: 9:16 vertical reel, 10s clip, Bella phone-forward tight close-up to camera
script.voTextV10_1: Nobody under forty... is finding La Grotta tonight. It's not the food. It's one line... of Google text. Enzo and Maria have run this room for years.
script.voTiming: ~9.0-9.5s VO in a 10s clip; ~0.5s breath head, ~0.3s tail; '...' = ~250-300ms beat pause
script.captionHook: Check your Google Business listing right now. What does it actually say?
script.commentBait: One of you has a 'permanently closed' pill on your listing right now — probably without knowing. Check. Screenshot it.

scenePrompts.spec: Phone-Forward Dominant Screen, tight close-up; phone bottom ~55%, face peeking above; Google Maps listing GREY 'Permanently closed' pill, hours 'Closed'
Same composition; Google Maps pill flips to GREEN 'Open · Closes 10 pm', hours 'Open'; smile deepens a fraction

items.motionIntent: Hold frame, tight close-up. Bella speaks unhurried/warm; real breath before first word; beat pause between sentences; natural blink ~3s & ~7s; subtle shoulder settle on opening line; eyebrow micro-lift on 'food' and 'Google text'; on 'one line of Google text' phone lifts <=3% toward lens as Maps pill flips GREY 'Permanently closed' -> GREEN 'Open · Closes 10 pm', hours Closed->Open; eyes locked to lens throughout (Camera Address Mandate).
items.cameraDirective: Hold frame. Static eye-level close-up. No zoom, no pan, no Dutch tilt. Clean axis.
items.continuityLink: Wardrobe = continuity; lighting = warm tungsten + cool window light. Phone stays portrait, no tilt/flip.
items.finalCut: day1_reel_VEO_voiced.mp4 (58.2s, 1080x1920) — shot1 locked c031855f + shots 2-9 Veo 3.1 voiced. See renders/ledger.json day1_reel_shots_2_9.
